location.description: Location where the OAuth client credential is created. Must always be global.
location.rationale: Restricting location to global ensures consistent IAM control and avoids regional misconfiguration.

oauthclient.description: Parent OAuth client identifier used to associate the credential.
oauthclient.rationale: Invalid client associations can lead to unauthorized credential binding.

oauth_client_credential_id.description: Unique credential ID. Must follow 4–32 chars, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Cannot start with 'gcp-'.
oauth_client_credential_id.rationale: Strict naming prevents insecure or reserved prefix usage.

disabled.description: Indicates whether the credential is disabled.
disabled.rationale: Disabled credentials cannot be used for authentication.

project.description: GCP project where the resource is created. If not set, provider project is used.
project.rationale: Ensures correct project scoping for IAM isolation.
